title: The voices: the house's ten most said lines in V-a to V-d, made and played by the game's code
about: Your words of 2026-11-15: "Sound design is pretty weak". In v0.0.19 the house said 237 lines over six lanes and 55 made a sound: the instructor was a text box. Now every line is said in a voice made by code (no recording): the instructor on the catwalk's PA (110 Hz, the horn's 300 Hz to 3.4 kHz), your #2 through his helmet's speaker (125 Hz, 250 Hz to 5 kHz), you in your own helmet (118 Hz, 6 dB under his shout). Each view draws the ten lines said most often in one set, their level over their spoken time and each word's start. Open a view live (O) to hear them: 1 to 9 and 0 a line, Space all ten. In play the Esc menu's To score page switches the set live (and &voice=a..d, or old, anywhere). The drill instructor's own line stays text: his voice is in your head.
